title: Croatian Papelon Porridge
description: A traditional Croatian dish made with papelon, light ingredients, and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: 1. Boil 4 cups of water in a large bowl.
2. Add the Papelon and cook for 10 minutes.
3. Stir in the special grains and cook for 5 more minutes.
4. Remove from heat and stir in the honey and malty creamer.
5. Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
